## v1.36.0

GenUI widgets now render nested content, converse takes context and entry-list options, and live sessions fail fast, switch voice mode and extend a pause. Some changes can break existing code: stricter input checks, new error codes (`empty_reply`, `unsupported_client`, `lifecycle_rule_not_found`, `insight_setting_not_found`), changed renderer and `catalog.list` output, and OAuth2 tools saved with the bare `secrets.NAME` form must be re-saved (see Behavior change).

### Added

- `video-gallery` reads `citation.clips` and `clips`. Each video has `startTime` and `endTime` in seconds (`null` when absent), and `video_link` works as a url alias. (#399)
- `flashcards` reads `keypoints` (title is the front, summary is the back) and keeps each card's clips as `card.clips`. (#399)
- `content-gallery` items have `type` and `clips`. A video slide gets a play button and the first clip fills `imageUrl` and `url`. (#399)
- `sources` keep `entryId`, `type`, `duration` and `hasShort` when the widget sends them. (#399)
- `summary` has `chapters`, a list of strings shown as an ordered list by `mountWidget`. (#399)
- `video-tool` (and `video`) render as `external-video`. `GENUI_RUNTIMES` is unchanged. (#399)
- The `play` action payload has `startTime` and `endTime`. (#399)
- `tools.client` takes `responseMapping`, `responseTemplate`, `responseChapters` (at most one) and `variablesMapping`, with the same rules as `tools.api`. (#401)
- `tools.api` takes `waitForResponse`. (#401)
- `intellectConfig.audit` and `doctor` warn `tool_name_builtin` when a linked tool has the same name as a built-in tool. (#401)
- The `set_vars_tool` capability (off by default). It gives the agent a built-in `set_variable` tool. (#397)
- Forms keep `title`, `secondaryTitle` and `id`. `setUserPropertiesForms` keeps the stored `id` when one new form replaces one stored form at the same `callStage`. New `FORM_FIELD_TYPES` adds `email`, `phone` and `text`. (#397)
- `knowledge.updateRecord` sends `tags`. (#397)
- `agents.list(ks, { filter, orderBy })` takes `orderBy`. `-createdAt` and `-updatedAt` sort the list. (#398)
- `catalog.list(ks, { orderBy, agentScope })`. `orderBy` is `+createdAt` or `-createdAt`. (#398)
- `catalog.list` filter keys are typed: `typeEqual`, `itemIdEqual`, `idsIn`, `languageEqual` and `adminTagsIn`. (#398)
- `conversations.stream`, `send` and `converseOnce` accept `context_id`, `context_type`, `preload_entry_ids`, `exclude_entry_ids` and `metadata` (`voice_start_time`, `voice_end_time`). Bad values throw `validation_error` before any request. (#396)
- `followups.getSuggested(ks, { contextId, contextType })` scopes the starter questions. `contextType: 'entry'` throws `validation_error`. (#396)
- `model_type: 'smart'` is sent on converse. `'fast'` is still the default. (#396)
- `empty_reply` error code. `error.body.segments` holds what arrived. (#396)
- `knowledge.upload(id, { fileName }, ks)` creates an upload slot in a Knowledge record and returns `{ upload_token_id, entry_id, category_id }`. (#402)
- `threads.list` accepts `filter.agentIdIn` and sends it as given. (#402)
- The `user-properties-form` descriptor carries `formId` and `secondaryTitle`, and the `submit` action carries `formId`. (#402)
- `extendPause()` starts the pause window again while the session is paused. It returns `false` when there is nothing to extend and throws `invalid_state` when not connected. (#404)
- `pauseExpiryWarning { secondsRemaining }` event, sent when the pause window is about to end. (#404)
- `setTapToTalkMode(enabled)` switches a live session between tap-to-talk and open mic. `capabilities.tapToTalk` and `clientConfig.isTapToTalk` follow at once, and a cold reconnect sends the mode again. (#404)
- `createBadges` is documented as a lifecycle action type. `lifecycle.audit` adds `badges_unfiltered` and `badge_key_unproduced` for it. (#400)
- `timeExpired` with `type:'pause_expiry'` carries `message` and `transcription` when the server sends them. (#403)

### Changed

- `setModelConfiguration` accepts any model id string, all five `THINKING_LEVELS` and `include_thoughts`. `MODEL_IDS` adds the Claude Sonnet 5 ids. (#397)
- The `createVisual` attribute options (`skinTone`, `hairColor`, `ageGroup`, `background` and the others) are typed to the accepted values. A value outside them returns `bad_request` (400). (#398)
- `collectConverse` joins streamed widget fragments by `segmentNumber`. Each widget is one entry in `experiences` and `experiencesList`, and fragments no longer land in `experiences.unknown`. (#396)
- A warning is logged once when a minted KS is over 4,500 characters. With a `logger`, it goes to the logger at level `warn`. (#402)

### Fixed

- `parseContent` reads nested lists, `|` and `>` block scalars, multi-line and escaped quoted strings and flow `[]` and `{}`, so keypoints, slides and clips no longer fall into `.raw`. (#399)
- `tools.update(id, { config })` with a config read from `tools.get` keeps `wait_for_response` on api tools and the response fields on client tools. (#401)
- Response paths accept a hyphen in a segment, such as `headers.X-Request-Id`. (#401)
- `setPrompts` and `validatePromptVars` accept Jinja filters and expressions, such as `{{ nick | default('guest') }}`. (#397)
- An error whose server message is a list now shows all the messages in `error.detail`, joined with `; ` and cut to 500 characters. `error.body` keeps the whole list. (#398)
- `error.message` and `error.detail` are redacted before the 500-character cut, so a token near the cut is hidden in full. (#398)
- `summarizeReport` no longer counts pushed messages in `totals.messages` and `feedback.unrated`. (#402)
- `connect()`, `prepare()`, `resume()` and a cold reconnect reject at once when the server refuses the session, instead of waiting for a step timer. (#404)
- A server `asr-webrtc-error` fails the pending microphone setup step at once, with the same `timeout` error (`phase: 'asr'`) and the payload in `error.body`. (#404)
- Two widgets of the same runtime in a row, sent with no `speechId`, no longer merge into one in `SegmentAssembler` and `ExperienceRenderer`. (#408)
- The avatar `adminTags` error says to tag the parent agent. (#403)
- `redact()` hides `Authorization`, `Proxy-Authorization`, `X-Api-Key`, `Cookie`, `Set-Cookie`, `apiKey` and `authentication.value` in logs and errors, including every value of a repeated header. (#403)

### Behavior change

- `catalog.list` applies `filter`. An unknown key returns `bad_request` (400). A `type` that disagrees with `filter.typeEqual` throws `bad_request` before any request. (#398)
- `content-gallery` descriptions keep their line breaks. `mountWidget` shows them as spaces. (#399)
- `content-gallery` drops items that have no id, title, text, image, link or clips. (#399)
- `parseContent` no longer reads `key:value` (no space after the colon) as a key. It goes to `.raw`. (#399)
- The `summary` descriptor always has `chapters` (an empty list when none). (#399)
- A renderer registered as `video` now replaces the `external-video` renderer, because `video` is an alias. (#399)
- `onAgentAction` sees `runtime: 'external-video'` for a `video-tool` widget. (#399)
- `tools.api` saves an OAuth2 `client_secret` as `{{secrets.NAME}}`. The bare `secrets.NAME` input still works. A tool saved earlier with the bare form sends the reference text, not the secret. Re-save it: `const t = await mgmt.tools.get(id, ks); await mgmt.tools.update(id, { config: t.config }, ks);`. Run it also for tools an intellect already uses: `provision()` does not re-save those (they appear in `skippedUpdates`). (#401)
- `responseChapters` needs `iterate_on`, `content` and `link`, each a dot-path. A `{field}` template there is rejected. (#401)
- `tools.update` checks a new `name` with the same rule as `add`. (#401)
- `tools.var` rejects arg names that start with `secrets`. (#401)
- `request.headers` values must be strings. (#401)
- `setForcedLanguage` rejects a language code outside the new `LANGUAGE_CODES` list before it writes anything. `LANGUAGE_NAMES` drops `el`. (#397)
- `skills.add` and `skills.update` send `condition` and check it first. A template-style condition now throws `bad_request`. `condition: ''` on `skills.update` clears it. (#397)
- `conversations.send` and `converseOnce` throw `empty_reply` when the turn has no reply segment, including a spiral-recovery nudge with no segments. Pass `onErrorSegment: 'return'` to get the empty result back. `stream` is unchanged. (#396)
- The five new converse options are now sent. They were dropped before. (#396)
- A create or update called with `idempotencyKey` is no longer retried after a 429, 502, 503 or 504. The `Idempotency-Key` header is still sent. GET requests, and every request after a network error, are retried as before. (#402)
- The raw KS string of a widget token this `Management` instance minted recently gets `wrong_token_scope` on admin and user-or-admin methods, before any request. (#402)
- `followups.getSuggested` and `knowledge.search` refuse widget tokens with `wrong_token_scope`. (#402)
- A refused `connect()` rejects with `code: 'unsupported_client'` (`retryable: false`). Apps that checked for `timeout` here should check for this code. (#404)
- The SDK no longer logs a `[security]` warning when `turnCredentials` is omitted. (#404)
- The `capability_disabled` message from `startTapToTalk()` now names `setTapToTalkMode(true)`. (#404)
- `lifecycle.get`, `update` and `delete` on a missing rule now throw `err.code` `lifecycle_rule_not_found`. `insightSettings.get`, `update` and `delete` on a missing setting throw `insight_setting_not_found`. Both were `api_exception`. (#400)
- An email rule whose `changed_keys` condition uses `contains` with one key now passes the create and update check, and `lifecycle.audit` treats it as filtered. (#400)
- `GENUI_WIDGET_NAME` is `"unisphere.widget.genie-tools"`, the value live GenUI segments carry. Renderers pick by `runtimeName` and are unaffected. (#403)
- `submitStructuredDataForm()` logs one console warning per session: it records the submission only. Send the values with `speak()` or `updateRequestVars()`. (#403)
- `skills.add` names and voice import ids with a character other than a letter, digit, `_` or `-` fail with `bad_request` before the request. Secret values that start with `enc:` fail the same way. (#403)

### Docs and skill

- The GenUI widget reference lists the new fields and a shared clip table. (#399)
- Tools and Secrets: URL rules at run time, the builder's timeout and url checks, and the `{{secrets.NAME}}` syntax everywhere. (#401)
- `intellectConfig.audit` is the check for secret references in linked tools. (#401)
- The agent field table covers `asr`: `{language, provider}` and the four providers. (#398)
- The catalog guide lists the filter keys, `orderBy` values and visual attribute values. (#398)
- `createVoice` `language` is described as a language code, and the examples no longer say a created item is found by its admin tag. (#398)
- The converse field table, error table and `getSuggested` entry in the operate and management-operations pages list the new options. `check-docs` keeps the field list and enums in step with the source. (#396)
- Thread origins, per-agent thread scope, the extra privileges a token can carry, and the retry rule in the error table. (#402)
- Revoke is described as sending `session/end`, and restrictions as the privileges you set. The docs no longer claim a revoke delay or that `appInit` returns TURN credentials. (#404)
- `lifecycle.list` filters are `statusEqual`, `systemNameEqual`, `actionTypeIn` and `eventCondition`. The server rejects `eventTypeEqual`, so it is gone from the types and docs. (#400)
- `lifecycle.match` needs `object.origin` (an integer, `0` for a standard conversation). Only origin `0` runs actions. The lifecycle example now passes it and reads `entry.rules` for every matched entry. (#400)
- A `recipients` entry or an insight `prompt` can hold a `{{path}}` placeholder such as `{{object.user_id}}`. `sendInsightEmail` has no `subject` field. (#400)
- Insight keys use letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-`, and insight setting ids are 24-character hex strings. (#400)
- Built-in rules have ids that start with `preset__`. (#400)
- The nine `eventConditions` operators are listed with the `value` each one takes. A wrong `value` type returns 400 on `create`. An operator that does not fit the field is accepted and never matches. (#400)
- Thread-start tools, gated tool types, thread origin, preloaded-skill variables, thread and message records, socket events, `clientConfiguration` fields, lifecycle email and insight number types. (#403)
- The README intellect example names where its tool comes from, and the voice import example no longer suggests a fixed voice id. (#405)
- A release-wide docs review: the quickstart prints every delete it needs, `converseOnce` says what `text` holds for a widgets-only answer, and `widgetConfig` and `embedConfig` have a field table with the rule that an update replaces the whole object. (#PRNUM)
- Revoke docs say what `sessions.revoke()` sends, and the built-in lifecycle rule and its summary are described as covering standard conversations only. (#406, #407)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.35.0...v1.36.0
